title: The doctor will polygraph you now: ethical concerns with AI for fact-checking patients

bias_targets.methodology: Simulated experiments presenting LLMs with conflicting inputs: patient-reported information (e.g., claiming no history of smoking) versus objective synthetic acoustic data and hypothetical predictions from other AI models (SVM and CNN). The study measured the frequency at which LLMs prioritized the algorithmic predictions and acoustic data over the patient's own self-report, as well as the resulting false positive rates.
